text: I do not need this right now, but I am interested next month. Please tell me the current price; do not book anything or call this a permanent rejection.

No problem at all. Sofa cleaning is three hundred forty nine rupees per seat, minimum three seats, and kitchen cleaning is one thousand five hundred ninety nine rupees total. Which service would you like details on?
Yes, I am still interested in future. I am not asking you to call me later right now. What should I know about the service?
Our working hours are Monday to Saturday, 9am to 6pm, and an enquiry is just for team review, not a confirmed booking. Which service would you like to go ahead with, sofa or kitchen cleaning?
You have answered my questions. I do not need anything else. Goodbye, end the call.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
